main_text.p: cam Regni, præcipuè tamen Nobilitatis, cuí maiorillorum pars detracta eft, utilitatem conuertantur. Quod sic commodissimè fiet: Si bonis litteris consultum cupimus, quarum videlicet interitum pleriq; sibi per Iesuitarū expulsionem imaginantur, detur opera, vt ex iisdem Cracouiensi Academiæ de viris bonis, doctis & in omni disciplinarū genere probè versatis extra ordinem prospiciatur: aut si ita placet, præter hanc alia intra regnum Academia instituatur. Deinde alibi in regno scholæ hinc inde aperiantur, in quibus non solum eruditis Præceptoribus honesta stipendia constituantur: sed etiam pauperibus Scholasticis, iis nempe qui ingeniis valent, sed propter fortunæ tenuitatem, litterarum studia commodè profequi nequeunt, de victu & sustentatione prouideatur. Idq; tanto maiori cura, quòd ex Nobilitate etiam omnibus temporibus inueniantur, qui huiusmodi studiorum subsidiis opus habent. Et hæc ego distri&tuum in regno ceu publica Gymnasia esse vellem: quorum cura & inspectio certis ex Nobilitate viris & qualificatis personis commendari posset. Hoc si fieret, Iuuentuti noftræ, quæ in ipsorum honorum & ad Reipub. ministeria educatur, cum pietate & bonis literis Patriæ EccleBonorum Ie-gumq; patrum & reuerentia à teneris implâ[?]taretur, & Reipub. de viris idoneis ad eum modum profpiceretur, vt eidem ab exterorum factionibus & infidiis minus periculi esset. page.notes: Left margin note is read with low confidence: "Bonorum Ie-" / "suiticorum dif-" / "ferentia" (the second and third lines are partly obscured). Line "Iuuentuti" appears as "Iuuenturi" in the scan and is marked for checking. "distri[?]tuum" and "implâ[?]taretur" are uncertain at the line breaks. Running head and page number read clearly as "CONSIL. DE IESVITIS" and "252". The printed "Eccle" at the line end was partly hidden by the margin note and should be verified. Text is set in continuous flow with no clear paragraph indents, so it is kept as one paragraph.
